correctness.rationale: For even n=2,4 directly compare Hamming-ball complements. For n=6,8,10,12,14, normalize first source 0, second source Hamming weight d<n, third source by its coordinate intersections, fourth by the four resulting block counts. This enumerates all automorphism orbits of ordered first-four source tuples, not a sample. Independently implemented C++ bitset enumeration for Q14 examined exactly 115600 representative classes and found per-d minima 2478,2478,1554,1554,1260,1260,1008,1008,900,900,800,800,650,650, so universal lower minimum 650; direct supplied two distinct C++ certificates and every-d saved output agree, with smaller n minima 5,16,53,185. Total later ball capacities 0,1,12,93,592 are strictly smaller than these minima. Q14 explicit (0,4095,12415,16257) attains 650, so sharpness is real. This is exact finite orbit exhaustion; it does not establish conjecture for n>=16.
